name: security-standard
description: Risk-based application security workflow for code changes, repositories, threat modeling, validation, and remediation.

interface.shortDescription: Review security risks and produce validated fixes.
interface.longDescription: Security Standard provides an original, risk-based AppSec workflow for reviewing diffs or repositories, modeling threats, validating findings, reducing false positives, fixing vulnerabilities, and reporting evidence by application layer.
defaultPrompt: Review this diff for security regressions.
Run a scoped security audit on this repository.
Validate and fix this security finding.
